id.description: Id for the new item. An id the list already holds adds nothing.

text.description: Text of the new item. Whitespace around it is dropped.

hideChecked.description: Whether the list hides the items that are checked off.

checked.description: Whether each item is checked off, by item id.

items.description: Every item on the list, in the order they were added.

id.description: Stable id, minted by whoever asked for the item.

resultSchema.description:
A list of items, each of which can be checked off. Read `state.items` for
what is on it, and add to it with `addItem`.

addItem.description:
Add one item. Mint a fresh `id` for each item; sending an id the list
holds already adds nothing, so sending the same event again is safe.

output.description: Whether the frame hides checked-off items, for everyone on the piece.

state.description: The items, and which of them are checked off, by item id.
